title: Dean's MapReduce: coordinate with failure
summary: In a cluster of a thousand machines something is always failing. Instead of preventing every failure, MapReduce coordinates with it: the master re-assigns a crashed machine's task to a healthy node, so the whole web can be processed on unreliable parts.
source: Ch07 — Jeff Dean on computation, distribution and failure handling
